claim_under_attack.capability_text_quoted: Ridge regression fit of Y_gi values on 807 scaffold-safe train polymers from Polyuniverse Epoxy, with 168 scaffold-safe held-out test polymers. Directly resolves the Phase-1 question flagged in the prior 15-polymer Ridge receipt. MAJOR FINDING: data-driven Y_gi calibration achieves test MAE = 22.0 K (matching Bicerano's ~30 K target), BEATING the published Y_gi baseline MAE = 54.6 K by 32.6 K. Confirms the Van Krevelen 24-group STRUCTURE is correct and Bicerano-quality when properly calibrated on adequate data. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.

note_on_mechanism: best_alpha=1e-4 is functionally unregularized OLS on 24 correlated group features. Both sign-flipped groups (vinyl_CH2, nitrile) sit in the bottom third of training support (n_train_rank 7/24 and 9/24 respectively, i.e. the 24-group Ridge fit is least constrained exactly where it produces physically inadmissible signs), which is the same under-determination failure mode the module's own prior 15-polymer ridge-retuned receipt diagnosed and which this 1000-polymer receipt's claim_locks assert is 'now resolved' at n=807 total training polymers -- but is not resolved for the rare-group coefficients, only for the common-group ones.
pre_registered_refute_criterion: >=1 of 24 fitted Y_gi has sign opposite to its published (100% positive) counterpart => REFUTES '24-group structure confirmed correct' / 'under-determination hypothesis now resolved'
